name: Roska Upholstery
old_description: Welcome to the world of custom upholstery services! Here, we transform your furniture into stunning pieces that reflect your unique style and personality. Our skilled craftsmen are dedicated to providing high-quality materials and exceptional workmanship, ensuring your satisfaction every step of the way. Let us help you create the perfect look for your home!
about:
Roska Upholstery operates from Watertown, Connecticut. The company's founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources. The business presents itself as a custom upholstery and furniture manufacturing shop serving the greater Connecticut area.

The shop provides a range of furniture services: reassembly of broken pieces with re-gluing, reinforcement of frames including spring and webbing replacement, and full reupholstery with new fabric and padding. In addition to repair and restoration, Roska manufactures new furniture items such as ottomans, valances, headboards, and chests to customer specifications. The company also fabricates bathroom and kitchen linen sets and custom cushions for indoor and outdoor use.

Roska's work spans residential, commercial, and healthcare settings, with dedicated galleries for each segment as well as for outdoor/indoor cushions and repurposed furniture. Customers include homeowners seeking custom pieces, businesses outfitting commercial spaces, and healthcare facilities requiring specialized upholstery.

The company states that its skilled craftsmen use high-quality materials to deliver exceptional workmanship, aiming to transform furniture into pieces that reflect each client's unique style and personality.
